title: David Bowker (writer)
source:
{{short description|British author and screenwriter|bot=PearBOT 5}}
'''David Bowker''' is a [[UK|British]] [[author]] and [[screenwriter]]. Born in [[Manchester]], [[England]], Bowker has written seven novels. He has also worked as a journalist and as a [[columnist]] on ''[[The Times]]''.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.commapress.co.uk/?section=authors&page=bowkerpage |title=David Bowker |publisher=Comma Press |accessdate=2008-05-12}}</ref> He has various film projects in development and his TV work includes episodes of ''[[Casualty (TV series)|Casualty]]'' and ''[[Coronation Street]]''.  He is currently working on his eighth novel.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/entertainment/film_and_tv/s/220/220834_on_his_best_behaviour.html |author=Wylie, Ian |date=2006-08-16 |title=On his best behaviour |work=[[Manchester Evening News]] |accessdate=2008-05-12}}</ref>

Bowker's book, ''How to Be Bad'' was recommended by ''[[Esquire (magazine)|Esquire]]'' magazine as one of the books of 2005.<ref>{{cite news |title=Books of the Year |url=http://www.mywire.com/a/Esquire/Books-of-Year/1078595?extID=10051 |work=[[Esquire (magazine)|Esquire]] |date=1 December 2005 |accessdate=5 August 2009 }}</ref>

*''Rawhead'' (2002),<ref>{{cite news |title=Borrow this |url=http://www.highbeam.com/doc/1G1-91879524.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121026092342/http://www.highbeam.com/doc/1G1-91879524.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=26 October 2012 |work=[[Daily Mirror|The Mirror]] |date=21 September 2002 |accessdate=5 August 2009 }}</ref> retitled ''The Death You Deserve'' in 2003 for its American release

*''How To Be Bad'' (2005)<ref>{{cite news |title=Zany world of 'How to Be Bad' is quite good |url=https://pqasb.pqarchiver.com/chicagotribune/access/884164011.html?dids=884164011:884164011&FMT=ABS&FMTS=ABS:FT&date=Aug+19%2C+2005&author=Mario+Szichman%2C+Associated+Press&pub=Chicago+Tribune&desc=Zany+world+of+%27How+to+Be+Bad%27+is+quite+good&pqatl=google |archive-url=https://archive.today/20120718112700/http://pqasb.pqarchiver.com/chicagotribune/access/884164011.html?dids=884164011:884164011&FMT=ABS&FMTS=ABS:FT&date=Aug+19,+2005&author=Mario+Szichman,+Associated+Press&pub=Chicago+Tribune&desc=Zany+world+of+'How+to+Be+Bad'+is+quite+good&pqatl=google |url-status=dead |archive-date=July 18, 2012 |work=[[Chicago Tribune]] |date=19 August 2005 |accessdate=5 August 2009 | first1=Mario | last1=Szichman}}</ref>
